state: PROPOSED PRIVATE SOURCE API; no public/wire schema

functions.assembleProfileEvidence: (selection, configuration, artifacts, observations, attempt) -> deeply detached/frozen BOUND ProfileEvidenceV1; never called while RU configuration unavailable
functions.verifyProfileEvidence: (selection, configuration, artifacts, observations, attempt, evidenceSource) -> BOUND ProfileEvidenceV1 or fixed error; unbound attempt kind is explicitly not accepted as a bound carrier
functions.serializeProfileEvidence: (bound ProfileEvidenceV1 OR exact UnboundRUAttemptV1 data, transientCredentialValues) -> canonical UTF8 bytes, distinct closed kind/schema per branch; no new export/action language

selection: existing canonical factory brand, profile read-update|transactional, historyfalse only
configuration: existing factory-bound ServedProfileConfiguration, every actual field preserved; compare profile/history to selection and fixture digest to parsed artifacts

RU.set: existing branded ReadUpdateArtifactSet; copy exact sources through copyReadUpdateArtifactSetSources; retain current two-shard index/manifest/fixture/coverage policies

TX.coverage: ConformanceArtifactSource exact current coverageVersion1 bytes; preserve colon-joined assertion binding convention, not RU dot spelling
TX.binding: create canonical TXv2 bundle from exact supplied source; full required ownership map includes null for234 missing current IDs; no new TX index/action language

observations: closed array ordered by RU shard order or one TX owner transactional-baseline; each record has ownerId, sourceCommit, configuration(existing brand), runtimeConfigurationIdentity, exactConfiguration(non-secret transport record), ready summaries, reportSource(exact raw existing wrapper bytes containing result), expectedReportSha256, lifecycle record. Absent/failed reports can be null; no report substituted by wrapper. Report has existing ConformanceRunResultv4 fields, no custom runner result type.
reportExtraction: parse bounded exact existing wrapper source; read existing .result without altering it; rawWrapperSha256 binds exact bytes; canonicalResultSha256 is explicitly a derived digest, never an installed payload normalization. Unused unknown wrapper fields are neither trusted nor serialized. Compare whitelisted source/config/session fields to trusted context; no caller structural cast becomes a bound configuration.
attempt: closed data: outcome running|failed|observed; failureStages subset execution/assertion/cleanup/credential-check; owner states from existing writer; reported lifecycle facts/explicit unknown; sourceDirty boolean|null (null unavailable never false); unresolvedConditions list from frozen plan/adapters, not N/A certificates
ownData: reuse ownData/copySourceBytes intrinsic capture before parsing; reject proxies/getters/unknown API keys/functions; detach supplied source bytes and evidence data once. No file IO/process/network/service callbacks in pure module.
noTruthByHash: Expected hashes and labels establish byte identity only; trusted external installer/owner/root run provenance establishes truth. The carrier never verifies a service merely by agreement of its own assertions.
preBindingRU: Existing writer constructor/set/source/path/credentials and start/acquired have NO actual served configuration. Writer emits only distinct UnboundRUAttemptV1 until first safe genuine returned(report) supplies its existing factory-bound configuration. No fake bindServedProfileConfiguration call, new RU signature/caller parameter or guessed ready/target data.
TXWrapperHandoff: Before onObserved, observe captures detached genuine {result,sessions,baseline} plus source/entry. The existing positive onObserved owner serializes its EXACT legacy wrapper once if legacy output OR carrierPath is present, returns a closed optional {bytes:Uint8Array,rawWrapperSha256:string} only for carrierPath. Observe rehashes/copies those exact bytes and compares parsed .result, .sessions and .baseline against the pre-hook genuine snapshot. No file readback or legacy output dependency.
